lines: The cyborg holding the briefcase cannon ordered.
That was probably the commanding officer.
Lena, who had started to wage battle arbitrarily, stared blankly for a moment, but
The cyborgs with machine guns in their shoulders pointed the barrels of them in their direction, whereupon
Without hesitation, she stood in front of Asuka and readied her long sword, exposing herself to their gunpoints.
The machine guns in their shoulders (two per person) opened fire simultaneously.
Kin kin kin kin kin kin kin!!
Cherry blossoms fluttered about with a gust of wind, and Lena instantly repelled the bullets with a mysterious power.
Asuka could do similar things as well, but that was fairly dependant on the strength of her Android Arms.
Was this a move that made use of both her sword and some kind of wind-controlling powers? Lena was like a different person from the one who had been looking shaken up until mere moments ago.
Furthermore, she wasn't just deflecting the bullets, but killing their momentum, ensuring that no damage was done to her surroundings by any ricochets.
「Looks like it's true that you're a Hell Knight.」
While swinging her sword, Lena shouted at Asuka, who was unthinkingly admiring her.
「What are you doing?! Hurry and run away!」
「Even if you tell me to run......」
Although it was Lena who had started this battle by misunderstanding, it was Asuka who was being targeted by the cyborgs. Even if she did escape, they would probably chase after her.
Well, it seemed that Lena was supposed to receive the memory card in the first place, so it was right that she was battling the guys who were after it, though.
Putting that aside, because the cyborgs had started firing indiscriminately, the airport was in pandemonium.
Having seen that he couldn't bring them down with his men's gunfire, the leader pointed his suitcase cannon at them.
Whether explosive shells or incendiary bombs, either way, whatever they fired would undoubtedly be something that exploded on contact.
Without consulting Lena, who tried to cut a projectile down without hesitation, Asuka used her Wind Arts.
In front of the astonished Lena's eyes, a gust of wind broke out, and deflected the flying shell.
On the spur of the moment, Asuka had sent it flying in a direction were there were no people, but she couldn't do anything about what happened after that.
Sure enough, an explosion occurred in a corner of the airport.
Walls, pillars and the ceiling collapsed, and flames rose up one after another.
The airport, which was chaotic already, immediately switched over to full-scale panic.
However, she could picture Madam's angry face.
Lena was wide-eyed at the dismayed Asuka.
「More importantly than that, let's beat those guys!」
She firmly readied her demonic sword.
「I was holding back before, but this time, I'm gonna get a little more serious!」
Asuka got into a Wind Escape Art motion, about to use wind blades and whirlwind cuts.
But before she could, Lena's sword produced a different wind.
With a fierce, piercing shout, she swung her sword downwards.
As if to envelop her blade, which glowed a cherry colour, a large number of flower petals whirled up, along with a wind that was tinged with demonic power, and surged over towards the cyborgs.
Having transformed into sharp blades, the innumerable flower petals cut the cyborgs to shreds.
She hadn't labelled it a “Killer Blow” for nothing. It had staggering power.
Considering that the petals had turned into blades, they might have been better than Asuka's whirlwind cuts.
Furthermore, the sight of the cyborgs being destroyed amid a flutter of cherry blossom petals was, to coin a phrase, bloomin' lovely.
Asuka wound up mesmerized in spite of herself.
Lena, for her part, was striking a pose. Her cheeks had broken into a little bit of a grin.
「That's right. I'm Lena. Proud Hell Knight of Nomad!」
「She's not even trying to hide anything......」
She was so brazen that Asuka couldn't help but want to quip at her.
It was a natural question, but Asuka was a little flustered.
After all, the other person was a Hell Knight from Nomad. There was no way she could disclose her true identity.
「Eh? M-Me? Umm, I'm a wind user, who just happened to pass by.」
「Is that so? You really saved me, there.」
Lena readily accepted the vague answer that had come out on the fly.
She appeared to be the type not to dwell on details too much.
「But, it looks like those guys were targeting you, not me, right? What's up with that?」
It looked like Asuka couldn't gloss over that after all.
She would have to explain, starting with the fact that she had already received the memory card by mistake, and ask Lena the situation in detail.
She was thinking that, when a high-pitched voice resounded.
「What the hell is going on here?!!」
